prompt: Edit this Schedule Downloader mockup, preserving every label, control, section, data row, and the exact layout. Correct only the brand styling to The Lobby's pinned Local Co-op system: the full page ground is solid saturated seafoam #74cebf; flat section surfaces are pale mint #dcf4ee with strong 2px navy #233552 outlines and rounded corners. Every single letter, link, rule, icon, checkbox and radio uses navy #233552. Replace ALL bright blue links, blue control accents, pale-blue borders and grey type with navy. No white cards, no gradients, no soft shadows on cards, no silver or grey colors. Primary buttons retain solid custard #ffd983 faces with solid coral #ff845c tactile bases and navy outlines. Calendar choice labels are text-only Apple, Google, Outlook with no provider logos. Remove soccer-ball decorations from selected team rows; keep team names and remove controls. The mockup must feel like the same seafoam-and-navy world as The Lobby, not a generic white-and-blue interface. Keep text crisp and all details readable.
initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a crisp, high-fidelity mobile web product screen for The Lobby's Schedule Downloader, edge to edge in a tall portrait phone-width page, no phone hardware or browser frame. This is a complete scrolling page, not a poster. The attached existing welcome screenshot contributes only the established palette, rounded Rubik headings, Nunito Sans body and tactile custard button with coral base; do not copy its composition, scenery, huge heading or welcome text.
Visitor job: find Boise soccer teams and put their games in a calendar without signing in. Team-builder composition: compact header "The Lobby" with quiet "Sign in"; modest title "Schedule Downloader"; lead "Your team's games, in your calendar." and "Boise · No sign-in needed".
Immediately show "Find a team", labelled search input "Team name" with query "Comets" and small Search button, links "Use a Team ID" and "Browse divisions". Below, selected-team area with two removable rows: "Boise Comets · 2 games" and "Evening Owls · 2 games", plus "Add another team".
Next "Choose games" with "Remaining games selected", two checked sample rows for Boise Comets: "Wed 14 Oct · 7:15 pm" / "vs River City · Field 1", "Wed 21 Oct · 8:00 pm" / "vs North End · Field 2", and "Show Evening Owls games". Note "Boise time · 45-minute games".
Then "Get your calendar" and "2 teams · 4 games selected". Standard calendar selector Apple / Google / Outlook, Apple selected. Two flat radio rows: "Session link — Updates during this Session" selected, "Download .ics — One-time copy". Help: "Tap below, then confirm in Apple Calendar." One full-width tactile "Open in Apple Calendar", quiet "Copy Session link". Note "Anyone with this link can use it. Calendar updates may take time."
Quiet footer "Sample teams and games" and "Privacy". Clear generous touch targets, no decorative artwork, legible aligned controls, navy text throughout.
sampleData: All teams and games are fictional; this is a static concept, not an implemented route.
